scope: Typed AccordLock kernel ReasonCode values only; untyped plain-policy baseline strings are excluded.

codes.name: ALLOWED
codes.description: All checks in the current local kernel passed; this is not an independent production assurance claim.

codes.name: UNKNOWN_ACTION
codes.description: The schema version or operation is not supported by the fixed local profile.

codes.name: ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED
codes.description: The actor value is not allowed by active policy; the actor must first be bound by authenticated ingress.

codes.name: REPOSITORY_NOT_ALLOWED
codes.description: The proposed source repository is outside active policy.

codes.name: IMAGE_REPOSITORY_NOT_ALLOWED
codes.description: The proposed image repository is outside active policy.

codes.name: TARGET_NOT_ALLOWED
codes.description: The proposed cluster or namespace is outside active policy.

codes.name: CALLER_SECURITY_FACT_REJECTED
codes.description: The tenant or actor asserted in the proposal differs from the identity established by authenticated ingress.

codes.name: EVIDENCE_SIGNATURE_INVALID
codes.description: COSE decoding, protected-header checks, signature verification, canonical payload reconstruction, or payload equality failed.

codes.name: ATTESTER_NOT_REGISTERED
codes.description: No current registered attester matches the asserted issuer and key identifier.

codes.name: ATTESTER_SCOPE_VIOLATION
codes.description: Attester tenant, environment, status, or registered scope does not authorize the assertion.

codes.name: EVIDENCE_DEFECTIVE
codes.description: Accepted evidence does not meet the required completeness profile.

codes.name: EVIDENCE_STALE
codes.description: Evidence is expired or older than the active policy authorizations.

codes.name: EVIDENCE_FROM_FUTURE
codes.description: Evidence observation time is later than the trusted evaluation time.

codes.name: AUTHORITY_EPOCH_MISMATCH
codes.description: The evidence authority vector is not exactly equal to the current local authority vector, including roots, epochs, and activation identifiers.

codes.name: MISSING_REVIEW
codes.description: No accepted review assertion matches the proposed repository and commit.

codes.name: REVIEW_NOT_APPROVED
codes.description: The matching authoritative review assertion reports that approval is absent.

codes.name: REVIEW_COMMIT_MISMATCH
codes.description: A review assertion does not bind the proposed repository and commit.

codes.name: REVIEW_GRADE_INSUFFICIENT
codes.description: The registered attester grade for the matching review is below active policy.

codes.name: MISSING_BUILD
codes.description: No accepted assertion of kind BUILD is present.

codes.name: BUILD_FAILED
codes.description: The matching authoritative build assertion reports failure.

codes.name: BUILD_COMMIT_MISMATCH
codes.description: A build assertion does not bind the proposed repository and commit.

codes.name: BUILD_GRADE_INSUFFICIENT
codes.description: The registered attester grade for the matching build is below active policy.

codes.name: MISSING_ARTIFACT
codes.description: No artifact assertion is available for evaluation.

codes.name: ARTIFACT_SIGNATURE_INVALID
codes.description: The matching authoritative artifact assertion reports an invalid artifact signature.

codes.name: ARTIFACT_QUARANTINED
codes.description: The matching authoritative artifact assertion reports that the artifact is quarantined.

codes.name: TRANSFORM_OUTPUT_MISMATCH
codes.description: Build run and output digest do not link to the proposed artifact, or no matching artifact exists.

codes.name: MISSING_TARGET_SNAPSHOT
codes.description: No accepted target assertion matches the proposed target identity.

codes.name: TARGET_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
codes.description: Target cluster, namespace, deployment, or deployment UID differs from the proposal.

codes.name: TARGET_STATE_MISMATCH
codes.description: Target resource version, current image, or projection hash differs from the proposed prior state.

codes.name: MALFORMED_COMMIT
codes.description: The proposed commit identifier is not a lowercase or uppercase forty-character hexadecimal SHA-1 object identifier.

codes.name: INVALID_VALIDITY_WINDOW
codes.description: Evidence valid-until is not later than observed-at.

codes.name: POLICY_ROOT_MISMATCH
codes.description: The canonical active policy hash differs from the active policy authority root.

codes.name: EVIDENCE_REQUEST_MISMATCH
codes.description: The connector evidence-set request identifier or a signed evidence assertion request identifier differs from the proposal request identifier.
